title: Bourse French Tech Emergence (BFTE)
eligibility: Deeptech startups less than 1 year old, demonstrating breakthrough technological innovation with a strong link to research or high IP barriers.
verification_notes: Template entry utilizing established Bpifrance BFTE deeptech incubator guidelines. Re-verify exact deeptech consortium partnerships for 2026.
funding_objective: To finance the crucial proof-of-concept phase for early-stage deeptech startups, covering feasibility studies and initial technical development.
short_summary: A non-dilutive grant of up to €90,000 for highly innovative French deeptech startups under 1 year old.
full_description: The Bourse French Tech Emergence (BFTE) is a highly competitive subsidy managed by Bpifrance, designed specifically for deeptech projects with strong scientific differentiation. It subsidizes up to 70% of eligible costs associated with technical feasibility, market studies, and proof-of-concept development. The grant aims to bridge funding gaps before a company is ready to attract private VC funding or enter programs like French Tech Seed.
application_process: Founders must apply via their local Bpifrance regional directory following extensive interactions with a Bpifrance innovation charge d'affaires.
required_documents: Deeptech business plan, scientific bibliography, proof of company creation (Kbis), and technical justification.
incubator_or_partner_support: Applicants usually must be accompanied by a certified incubator or part of the French Tech network.

title: Bpifrance Innovation Funding (Aide à l’Innovation)
funding_amount: Variable depending on project scope (grants, advances, and loans available)
eligibility: Innovative startups and SMEs in France developing new products, services, or technologies with strong commercial potential.
geographic_eligibility: Registered company in France or project conducted within France.
verification_notes: Based on official Bpifrance innovation support schemes. Exact funding structure varies by programme (grants, repayable advances, and loans).
funding_objective: To support innovation, product development, and commercialization by French startups and SMEs.
short_summary: A set of public funding programmes supporting innovation projects in France through grants, loans, and repayable advances.
full_description: Bpifrance provides a range of innovation funding mechanisms designed to support French startups and SMEs at different stages of development. These include non-repayable grants, repayable advances, and innovation loans. The programmes focus on helping companies develop new technologies, validate products, and bring innovations to market. Funding terms depend on project maturity, innovation level, and economic impact.
application_process: Applications are submitted directly through Bpifrance or via regional innovation support channels. Projects are evaluated based on innovation, feasibility, and market potential.
required_documents: Business plan, innovation description, financial forecasts, and technical documentation.
incubator_or_partner_support: Support from incubators, accelerators, or regional innovation agencies may strengthen applications.

title: France 2030 i-Nov Innovation Contest (Concours d'innovation)
funding_amount: Up to €2,250,000 (funding intensity of 35% to 45% of eligible project costs between €600k and €5m)
eligibility: French startups and SMEs conducting R&D and innovation projects aligned with France 2030 priority themes (typically TRL 4–7). Project structure may vary by call.
application_deadline: Wave-based (Vagues) - Check Bpifrance calendar for current wave
verification_notes: Funding typically combines grants and recoverable advances. Exact ratios depend on project and call conditions.
funding_objective: To accelerate the emergence of leading companies with international reach in domains critical to the France 2030 transition.
short_summary: A France 2030 programme supporting R&D and innovation projects by startups and SMEs, with funding covering a portion of eligible costs.
full_description: The i-Nov Innovation Contest, a flagship of the France 2030 plan, co-finances high-potential research, development, and innovation projects for startups and SMEs. Projects must have a total cost between €600,000 and €5 million, lasting 12 to 36 months, focusing on strategic themes like health, ecological transition, and digital sovereignty. The financial aid covers 35-45% of eligible costs and is typically structured as 60% direct subsidy and 40% recoverable advance.
application_process: Submission through official portals (Bpifrance or ADEME depending on call), followed by evaluation and potential selection phases.
required_documents: Comprehensive technological innovation dossier, commercialization plan, and detailed financial forecasting covering 12-36 months.
incubator_or_partner_support: Not required, but projects must show strong technological maturity and independence.

title: PLACE - French State Public Tenders
funding_amount: Varies by tender (no fixed funding amount; contract value depends on each consultation)
eligibility: Businesses may bid subject to the requirements of each individual tender and applicable exclusion rules.
short_summary: PLACE is the French State's official e-procurement platform where companies can search, access, and submit responses to public tenders issued by State services and related public bodies.
full_description: PLACE is the French State’s official e-procurement portal where businesses can find and respond to public tender opportunities published by State services and related public bodies.
provider_organization: French Ministry of the Economy / Direction des achats de l'État (DAE)
application_process: Create an account on the PLACE portal, locate a relevant consultation, review the tender documents, prepare the required candidature/offer documents, and submit electronically before the stated deadline.
required_documents: Varies by tender. Documentation requirements are defined in each consultation’s tender documents. Where applicable, standard procurement forms or DUME may be used depending on the procedure.
verification_notes: Verified from official French government procurement sources. This is a tender portal, not a grant scheme.
